speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Hypertensive Headache with Transient Visual Disturbances (likely due to uncontrolled hypertension).

Given your history of hypertension and the absence of nausea or peripheral vision loss, this strongly suggests a hypertensive crisis causing vascular headaches and transient visual symptoms rather than a primary neurological emergency. Please ensure your blood pressure is monitored closely and adjusted immediately.
